title: 正念正知
note: 行住坐卧、饮食、日常正知

evidence.pali: 109 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti. Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati…pe… evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 109. 复次，诸比丘，比丘于前行、后退时，于前看、旁顾时，于屈、伸时，于持用僧伽梨、钵、衣时，于食、饮、嚼、尝时，于大小便时，于行、住、坐、卧、醒、语、默时，皆具足正知。如是，于内身随观身而住……（中略）……诸比丘，比丘如是于身随观身而住。
evidence.english: 109. “Furthermore, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu acts with clear comprehension when going forward and returning; he acts with clear comprehension when looking ahead and looking aside; he acts with clear comprehension when bending and stretching; he acts with clear comprehension when wearing the double-layered robe, bowl, and outer robe; he acts with clear comprehension when eating, drinking, chewing, and savoring; he acts with clear comprehension when defecating and urinating; he acts with clear comprehension when walking, standing, sitting, sleeping, waking, speaking, and being silent. Thus he dwells contemplating the body in the body internally… and so forth… In this way too, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body.”

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Apica cattāro dhammā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya saṃvattanti – satisampajaññaṃ, muṭṭhassatipuggalaparivajjanatā, upaṭṭhitassatipuggalasevanatā, tadadhimuttatāti. Abhikkantādīsu hi sattasu ṭhānesu satisampajaññena, bhattanikkhittakākasadise muṭṭhassatipuggale parivajjanena, tissadattattheraabhayattherasadise upaṭṭhitassatipuggale sevanena, ṭhānanisajjādīsu satisamuṭṭhāpanatthaṃ ninnapoṇapabbhāracittatāya ca satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati. Evaṃ catūhi kāraṇehi uppannassa panassa arahattamaggena bhāvanāpāripūri hotīti pajānāti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 再者，有四法有助于念觉支的生起：正念正知、远离失念之人、亲近具念之人、以及心向于此。在前进等七个方面以正念正知修习，像避开被丢弃食物的乌鸦一样远离失念之人，亲近像帝萨达多(Tissadatta)长老、无畏(Abhaya)长老那样具念之人，并且为了在行住坐卧等处生起正念，心倾向、倾斜、倾注于此，念觉支即会生起。他了知，如此通过四种因缘生起的念觉支，其修习的圆满是通过阿罗汉道而达成的。
entries.english: Furthermore, four states conduce to the arising of the enlightenment factor of mindfulness: mindfulness and clear comprehension, avoiding persons of lapsed mindfulness, associating with persons of established mindfulness, and an inclination towards that. For the enlightenment factor of mindfulness arises through mindfulness and clear comprehension in the seven instances such as going forward; by avoiding persons of lapsed mindfulness, who are like a crow that has dropped its food; by associating with persons of established mindfulness, like the Elders Tissadatta and Abhaya; and through a mind inclined, sloping, and tending towards arousing mindfulness in postures such as standing and sitting. One understands that for this factor, arisen through these four causes, the fulfillment of its development occurs by means of the path of arahantship.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Pāde pāda nti dakkhiṇapāde vāmapādaṃ. Accādhāyā ti atiādhāya īsakaṃ atikkamma ṭhapetvā gopphakena hi gopphake jāṇunā vā jāṇumhi saṅghaṭṭiyamāne abhiṇhaṃ vedanā uppajjati, cittaṃ ekaggaṃ na hoti, seyyā aphāsukā hoti; yathā pana na saṅghaṭṭeti, evaṃ atikkamma ṭhapite vedanā nuppajjati, cittaṃ ekaggaṃ hoti, seyyā phāsukā hoti. Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘pāde pādaṃ accādhāyā’’ti. Sato sampajāno ti satiyā ceva sampajānapaññāya ca samannāgato hutvā. Iminā supariggāhakaṃ satisampajaññaṃ kathitaṃ. Uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā ti asukavelāya nāma uṭṭhahissāmī’ti evaṃ uṭṭhānavelāparicchedakaṃ uṭṭhānasaññaṃ citte upetvā. Evaṃ katvā nipanno hi yathāparicchinnakāleyeva uṭṭhātuṃ yutto.
entries.chinese_simplified: ‘脚放在脚上’(pāde pādaṃ)是指左脚放在右脚上。‘交叠放置’(accādhāya)是指稍微交错重叠地放置。因为如果脚踝与脚踝或膝盖与膝盖相碰摩擦，就会频繁产生痛感，心不能专注，睡眠不舒适；如果彼此不碰触，就不会产生痛感，心能专注，睡眠舒适。因此说‘将一脚交叠置于另一脚上’。‘正念正知’(sato sampajāno)是指具足正念与正智。此处已说明善于把握的正念正知。‘作意起身想’(uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā)是指心中作意‘我将于某时起身’这样确定起身时间的想法。如是作意而卧者，就能在预定时间起身。
entries.english: ‘One foot on the other’ means the right foot on the left foot. ‘Accādhāya’ means placing it slightly beyond, slightly overlapping. For when the ankle presses against the ankle or the knee against the knee, frequent pain arises, the mind is not unified, and the posture is uncomfortable. But when they are placed so as not to press, no pain arises, the mind is unified, and the posture is comfortable. Therefore it is said, ‘placing one foot on the other, slightly overlapping.’ ‘Mindful and fully aware’ means being endowed with mindfulness and the wisdom of clear comprehension. By this, well-grasped mindfulness and clear comprehension are explained. ‘Having attended to the perception of rising’ means bringing to mind the perception of rising, which determines the time of rising, thus: ‘At such and such a time, I will rise.’ For one who lies down having done so is fit to rise at the predetermined time.

entries.pali: 182 . So abhikkante paṭikkante ti so manacchaṭṭhānaṃ indriyānaṃ saṃvarena samannāgato bhikkhu imesu abhikkantapaṭikkantādīsu sattasu ṭhānesu satisampajaññavasena sampajānakārī hoti. Tattha yaṃ vattabbaṃ siyā, taṃ jhānavibhaṅge vuttameva.
entries.chinese_simplified: 182. ‘他在前进、后退时’，是指这位具足意为第六的六根律仪的比丘，在前进、后退等这七种情况中，以正念正知而行事。其中应说之事，已在《禅那分别》(Jhānavibhaṅga)中说过。
entries.english: 182. 'When going forward and backward' means this bhikkhu, endowed with sense-restraint over the six sense faculties, acts with full awareness in these seven instances beginning with going forward and backward, through mindfulness and full comprehension. Whatever needs to be said about this has already been said in the exposition of jhāna.

entries.pali: 508 . Pātimokkhasaṃvarādī ti ādi -saddena indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, satisampajaññaṃ, jāgariyānuyogoti evamādike saṅgaṇhāti. Asubhānussatiyo ti asubhajhānāni, anussatijhānāni ca. Sati samaṇabhāvakarapubbabhāgakaraṇīyasampattiyaṃ samaṇabhāvopi siddhoyeva hotīti āha ‘‘suññā…pe… dassetī’’ ti. Kāraṇe hi siddhe phalampi siddhameva hotīti. Sikkhāpadānaṃ sarūpaṃ, sikkhitabbākāraṃ, saṅkhepato vibhāgañca dassetuṃ ‘‘sikkhāpadesū’’ tiādi vuttaṃ. Tattha nāmakāyādivasenā ti nāmakāyapadakāyabyañjanakāyavasena vuttesu. Iminā sikkhāpadānaṃ sikkhāya adhigamūpāyabhūtapaññattisabhāvataṃ dasseti. Tesu sikkhitabbākāro satthuāṇānatikkamoyevāti āha ‘‘vaca…pe… tabbesū’’ ti. Sikkhākoṭṭhāsesū ti vuttappabhedesu adhisīlasikkhābhāgesu. Tesu samādānameva sikkhitabbākāroti vuttaṃ ‘‘paripūraṇavasena sikkhitabbesū’’ ti. Sikkhāpadekadesabhūtā ti sikkhāpadasamudāyassa avayavabhūtā. Bhikkhusikkhā hi idhādhippetā ‘‘idha bhikkhū’’ti vuttattā. Tathā hi vakkhati ‘‘sesasikkhā pana atthuddhāravasena sikkhāsaddassa atthadassanatthaṃ vuttā’’ti (vibha. aṭṭha. 516).
entries.chinese_simplified: 508. 波罗提木叉律仪等：以“等”字包括守护根门、饮食知量、正念正知、勤行觉醒等。不净随念（asubhānussati）：指不净禅（asubhajhāna）与随念禅（anussatijhāna）。当成就沙门性的前分所作圆满时，沙门性也自然成就，所以说“空...显示”。因为因若成就，果亦成就。为了显示学处的体性、应学之行相及简要分别，所以说“于学处中”等。其中“以名身等”：指以名身（nāmakāya）、句身（padakāya）、文身（byañjanakāya）的方式所说。由此显示学处作为达成学处之方便所安立的自性。其中应学之行相就是不超越导师的教诫，所以说“语...应学”。于学分中：指已说种类中的增上戒学（adhisīlasikkhā）部分。其中受持就是应学之行相，所以说“应以圆满的方式修学”。属于学处一部分：即学处总集的组成部分。此处特指比丘学处，因说“于此，比丘（idha bhikkhu）”故。如是（义注）将说：“其余学处则是为了显示‘学’一词的含义而抉择其义所说”（Vibha. Aṭṭha. 516）。
entries.english: 508. 'Restraint of the Pātimokkha, etc.': by the word 'etc.' he includes guarding the sense doors, moderation in eating, mindfulness and clear comprehension, devotion to wakefulness, and so on. 'Recollection of the foul' means the jhānas on the foul and the jhānas that are recollections. When there is accomplishment of the preliminary duties that bring about the state of a recluse, the state of a recluse is indeed accomplished; therefore he says: 'he shows... empty...,' etc. For when the cause is accomplished, the result too is accomplished. To show the nature of the training rules, the way they are to be trained in, and their division in brief, the phrase 'in the training rules...,' and so on, is stated. Therein, 'by way of the body of names, etc.' means among those stated by way of the body of names, the body of terms, and the body of syllables. By this he shows that the training rules have the nature of a designation that is the means for attaining the training. Among them, the way they are to be trained in is simply not transgressing the Teacher's command; hence he says: '...in what is to be... by speech...,' etc. 'In the sections of the training' means in the aforementioned divisions that are parts of the training in the higher virtue. Among them, the way they are to be trained in is said to be the mere undertaking, with the words: 'in what is to be trained in by way of fulfilling.' 'Being a part of the training rules' means being a constituent of the collection of training rules. For the bhikkhu's training is intended here, because it is said, 'Here, a bhikkhu.' For so he will say: 'But the remaining trainings are stated for the purpose of showing the meaning of the word 'training' by way of extracting the meaning' (Vibh-a 348).

entries.pali: Tathā saparikkhārā pañcadasa caraṇadhammā pañca ca abhiññāyo. Tattha caraṇadhammā nāma sīlasaṃvaro, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, jāgariyānuyogo, satta saddhammā, cattāri jhānāni ca. Tesu sīlādīnaṃ catunnaṃ terasapi dhutadhammā, appicchatādayo ca parikkhāro . Saddhammesu saddhāya buddhadhammasaṅghasīlacāgadevatūpasamānussati- lūkhapuggalaparivajjanasiniddhapuggalasevanapasādanīya- dhammapaccavekkhaṇatadadhimuttatā parikkhāro, hirottappānaṃ akusalādīnavapaccavekkhaṇaapāyādīnavapaccavekkhaṇakusaladhammupatthambhana- bhāvapaccavekkhaṇahirottappa rahitapuggalaparivajjanahirottappasampannapuggalasevanatadadhimuttatā, bāhusaccassa pubbayogaparipucchakabhāvasaddhammābhiyogaanavajjavijjāṭṭhānādi- paricayaparipakkindriyatākilesadūrībhāvaappassutaparivajjanabahussutasevanatadadhimuttatā, vīriyassa apāyabhayapaccavekkhaṇagamanavīthipaccavekkhaṇadhammamahattapaccavekkhaṇa- thinamiddhavinodanakusītapuggalaparivajjanaāraddhavīriyapuggala- sevanasammappadhānapaccavekkhaṇatadadhimuttatā, satiyā satisampajaññamuṭṭhassatipuggalaparivajjanaupaṭṭhitassatipuggalasevanatadadhimuttatā, paññāya paripucchakabhāvavatthuvisadakiriyāindriyasamattapaṭipādanaduppañña- puggalaparivajjanapaññavantapuggalasevanagambhīrañāṇacariyapacca- vekkhaṇatadadhimuttatā, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ sīlādicatukkaṃ aṭṭhatiṃsāya ārammaṇesu pubbabhāgabhāvanā, āvajjanādivasībhāvakaraṇañca parikkhāro. Tattha sīlādīhi payogasuddhiyā sattānaṃ abhayadāne, āsayasuddhiyā āmisadāne, ubhayasuddhiyā ca dhammadāne samattho hotītiādinā caraṇādīnaṃ dānādisambhārānaṃ paccayabhāvo yathārahaṃ niddhāretabbo, ativitthārabhayena na niddhārayimha. Evaṃ sampatticakkādayopi dānādīnaṃ paccayoti veditabbā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 如是，具足资具的十五种行法和五种神通（亦是助缘）。其中，行法是指：戒防护、根门守护、饮食知量、勤修警觉、七正法以及四禅。其中，戒等四法的资具是十三头陀支和少欲等。在七正法中：信的资具是忆念佛、法、僧、戒、施、天、寂静，远离粗鄙之人，亲近柔和之人，省察可喜之法，并于彼等生起胜解；惭与愧的资具是省察不善的过患、恶趣的过患、善法的增长，远离无惭无愧者，亲近具惭愧者并于彼等生起胜解；多闻的资具是先前的修习、问询、勤修正法、熟悉无过失的学处等、根器成熟、远离烦恼，远离少闻者，亲近多闻者并于彼等生起胜解；精进的资具是省察恶趣的怖畏、省察行道、省察法的伟大、遣除昏沉睡眠、远离懈怠者、亲近精进者、省察正勤并于彼等生起胜解；念的资具是具足正念正知、远离失念者、亲近具念者并于彼等生起胜解；慧的资具是问询、明净事相的行持、根平等的行持、远离恶慧者、亲近具慧者、省察深智的行持并于彼等生起胜解。四禅的资具是戒等四法、在三十八所缘中修习前分，以及作意等五自在的成就。其中，以戒等的行持清净，能给予众生无畏施；以意乐清净，能行财物布施；以二者清净，能行法布施。如是，行法等作为布施等资粮的助缘性，应如理抉择，因恐过于冗长，此处不作详述。如是，当知成就轮等也是布施等的助缘。
entries.english: Similarly, there are the fifteen practices of conduct along with their requisites, and the five higher knowledges. Among these, the practices of conduct are: restraint in virtue, guarding the sense doors, moderation in eating, devotion to wakefulness, the seven good qualities, and the four jhānas. Of these, for the four beginning with virtue, the thirteen ascetic practices and qualities like fewness of wishes are the requisites. For the good qualities, the requisites are as follows. For faith: recollection of the Buddha, Dhamma, Saṅgha, virtue, generosity, deities, and peace; avoiding coarse people and associating with the refined; reflecting on inspiring qualities and being resolved on them. For conscience and moral shame: reflecting on the dangers of unwholesome states, the perils of the lower realms, and the state of being supported by wholesome qualities; avoiding those devoid of conscience and moral shame, associating with those who possess them, and being resolved on these qualities. For much learning: prior application, questioning, dedication to the true Dhamma, familiarity with blameless fields of knowledge, maturity of faculties, being far from defilements, avoiding the unlearned, associating with the learned, and being resolved on this. For energy: reflecting on the fear of the lower realms, reflecting on the path of progress, reflecting on the greatness of the Dhamma, dispelling sloth and torpor, avoiding the lazy, associating with the energetic, reflecting on right effort, and being resolved on it. For mindfulness: mindfulness and clear comprehension, avoiding the unmindful, associating with the mindful, and being resolved on it. For wisdom: a questioning attitude, making the subject-matter clear, bringing the faculties to balance, avoiding the unwise, associating with the wise, reflecting on the profound conduct of knowledge, and being resolved on it. For the four jhānas, the requisites are the fourfold foundation beginning with virtue, the preliminary development on the thirty-eight objects, and the making of mastery in adverting and so on. Herein, through purity of practice by means of virtue and so on, one becomes capable of giving fearlessness to beings; through purity of intention, of giving material gifts; and through purity of both, of giving the gift of the Dhamma. In this way, the status of the practices of conduct and so on as conditions for the requisites of generosity and so on should be determined as appropriate. We have not elaborated for fear of excessive detail. Thus, the wheels of accomplishment and other factors should also be understood as conditions for generosity and the like.

entries.pali: ‘‘Iti hidaṃ sīlaṃ nāma sabbasampattīnaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ, sabbabuddhaguṇānaṃ pabhavabhūmi, sabbabuddhakaradhammānamādi caraṇaṃ mukhaṃ pamukha’’nti bahumānaṃ uppādetvā kāyavacīsaṃyame, indriyadamane, ājīvasampadāya, paccayaparibhoge ca satisampajaññabalena appamattena lābhasakkārasilokaṃ mittamukhapaccatthikaṃ viya sallakkhetvā ‘‘kikīva aṇḍa’’ntiādinā (visuddhi. 1.19; dī. ni. aṭṭha. 1.7) vuttanayena sakkaccaṃ sīlaṃ sampādetabbaṃ . Ayamettha saṅkhepo, vitthāro pana visuddhimagge (visuddhi. 1.6) vuttanayena veditabbo. Tañca panetaṃ sīlaṃ na attano duggatiparikilesavimuttiyā, sugatiyampi, na rajjasampattiyā, nacakkavatti-nadeva-nasakka-namāra-nabrahmasampattiyā, nāpi attano tevijjatādihetu, na paccekabodhiyā, atha kho sabbaññubhāvena sabbasattānaṃ anuttarasīlālaṅkārasampādanatthamevāti pariṇāmetabbaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: “因此，此戒被称为一切成就的基础，一切佛陀功德之源，一切成佛之法的最初、首要、主要行。”应生起极恭敬心，于身语律仪、调伏诸根、命清净、资具受用，以正念正知之力，不放逸，观察利养、恭敬、名誉犹如伪装成朋友的敌人，并依《清净道论》等中所说‘如母鸡护卵’等理，应当恭敬地圆满戒行。此处是简要说明，详细内容应如《清净道论》中所述而知。然而，这戒行并非为了自身从恶趣、烦恼中解脱，亦非为了善趣，并非为了王位成就，亦非为了转轮王、天、帝释、魔罗、梵天之成就，亦非为了自证三明等，亦非为了独觉菩提，而是为了以一切智智成就一切众生无上之戒德庄严，应当如此回向。
entries.english: "Thus, this virtue is the foundation of all accomplishments, the ground from which all Buddha-qualities arise, the beginning, the practice, the face, and the foremost of all qualities that make one a Buddha." Having generated great respect, one should carefully perfect virtue with diligence, by the power of mindfulness and clear comprehension, restraining body and speech, mastering the senses, maintaining purity of livelihood, and wisely using requisites, discerning gain, honor, and fame as if they were an enemy with the face of a friend, and regarding them as "a bird's egg" and so forth, as described in the Visuddhimagga (1.19) and the Dīgha Nikāya Commentary (1.7). This is the summary here; the detailed explanation should be understood according to the method stated in the Visuddhimagga (1.6). Moreover, this virtue should not be dedicated for one’s own liberation from the defilements of miserable states or even for a happy destination, nor for sovereignty, nor for the attainments of a wheel-turning monarch, a deity, Sakka, Māra, or Brahmā, nor for the sake of attaining the threefold knowledge and so forth, nor for Paccekabodhi. Rather, it should be dedicated solely for the purpose of providing all beings with the adornment of unsurpassed virtue through the state of omniscience.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Athassa paṭhamajjhānā, vuṭṭhāya vidhinā yadā; Satassa sampajānassa, jhānaṅgaṃ paccavekkhato.
entries.chinese_simplified: 其后，当他如法地从初禅出定，具足正念正知而省察禅支时。
entries.english: Then, when he has arisen methodically from the first jhāna, mindful and clearly comprehending, he reviews the jhāna factors.

entries.pali: Evaṃ dutiyajjhānādhigamaṃ dassetvā idāni tadanantaraṃ adhigatadutiyajjhānassa taṃ vuttanayeneva vasībhūtaṃ katvā tattha āsannavitakkavicārapaccatthikatāya ceva oḷārikapītaṅgasamaṅgitāya ca dosaṃ disvā nikantiṃ pariyādāya tadoḷārikaṅgappahānāya sesasantaṅgapaṭilābhāya tadevārammaṇaṃ punappunaṃ manasikaroto tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ uppajjati, tappādakañca lokuttaraṃ, taṃ dassetuṃ ‘‘pītiyā ca virāgā’’ tiādimāha. Tattha virajjanaṃ virāgo, samatikkamo, tasmā virāgā. Ca -kārena vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamaṃ sampiṇḍeti ‘‘pītiyā ca virāgā, vitakkavicārānañca vūpasamā’’ti. Idañcetassa āgamanamaggaparidīpanatthaṃ, vaṇṇabhaṇanatthañca vuttaṃ. Upekkhako viharatī ti ettha upapattito ikkhati apakkhapatitā hutvā passatīti upekkhā, tatramajjhattatā. Tāya visadāya pītivirāgapadaṭṭhānāya thāmagatāya samannāgatattā tatiyajjhānasamaṅgī ‘‘upekkhako’’ti vuccati, vitakkādikkhobhābhāvena panesā ettheva paribyattakiccā jātā, na paṭhamajjhānādīsūti. Sato ca sampajāno ti puggalādhiṭṭhānena sati ca sampajaññañca vuttaṃ, idañca satisampajaññabaleneva ṭhitaṃ taṃpītisahacaritaṃ sukhaṃ, tato apanītaṃ vaccho viya bandhanabalena dhenuṃ pītiṃ na upagacchati, imasmiñca sati atimadhure sukhe yogino na sārajjanti, no aññathāti imampi atthavisesaṃ dassetuṃ idheva vuttanti veditabbaṃ. Sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedetī ti ettha kiñcāpi tatiyajjhānasamaṅgino sukhapaṭisaṃvedanābhogo natthi, evaṃ santepi yasmā tassa nāmakāyena sampayuttaṃ atipaṇītaṃ sukhaṃ, taṃsamuṭṭhitena tassa atipaṇītena rūpena rūpakāyo phuṭṭho, yassa phuṭṭhattā jhānā vuṭṭhitopi kāyikasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeyya, tasmā etamatthaṃ dassento ‘‘sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedetī’’ti āha. Yaṃ ta ntiādīsu ya nti yasmā, yaṃ jhānahetūti attho. Ta nti taṃ tatiyajjhānasamaṅgipuggalaṃ buddhādayo ariyā ācikkhanti pasaṃsanti. Kinti? ‘‘Upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’’ ti. Evaṃ ekaṅgavippahīnaṃ duvaṅgasamannāgataṃ tividhakalyāṇādiyuttaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ adhigantvā pavattatīti attho. Yaṃ pana jhānaṃ vibhaṅge ‘‘jhānanti upekkhā sati sampajaññaṃ sukhaṃ cittassekaggatā’’ti (vibha. 591) vuttaṃ, taṃ saparikkhāraṃ jhānaṃ dassetuṃ pariyāyena vuttaṃ. Upanijjhānalakkhaṇānaṃ pana sukhacittekaggatānaṃ vasena duvaṅgikamevetaṃ veditabbaṃ. Yathāha – ‘‘duvaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hotī’’tiādi (vibha. 624).
entries.chinese_simplified: 如此展示了第二禅的证得之后，现在接着说明：已证得第二禅者，依前述方法使其熟练自在后，看到第二禅的过患在于它接近作为敌对者的寻、伺，并且具备粗显的喜支，于是断除对它的喜爱，为了舍弃那粗显的支分并获得其余寂静的支分，而对同一所缘反复作意，此时第三禅那便生起了，以及作为其基础的出世间禅那。为了说明此点，而说‘由离喜故’(pītiyā ca virāgā)等。此中，‘离’(virāga)是远离、超越，因此说‘离喜’。通过‘ca’字，亦总括了寻、伺的止息（即‘由离喜故，亦由寻、伺止息故’）。说此话是为了阐明其证得的道路，也是为了称赞。‘住于舍’(upekkhako viharati)：此中，‘舍’(upekkhā)是中正地看，不偏不倚地看，即中舍性。因为具足第三禅那者具备了清净的、以离喜为立足点的、稳固的舍，所以被称为‘舍者’。而这种舍，由于没有寻等扰动，在此禅那中其作用才完全显现，不像在初禅等中那样。‘正念、正知’(sato ca sampajāno)：这是就补特伽罗(puggala)而说的念与正知。而此乐已脱离了与它俱行的喜，它正是依靠念与正知的力量而安住的；已从喜中移开，就像被绳索系缚的小牛无法接近母牛一样，它不会再回到喜那里。并且，于此极甜美的乐中，瑜伽行者不会生起贪著，否则便不然。为了显示此一特殊义理，也在此处如此说，应知。‘以身感受乐’(sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti)：此中，虽然具足第三禅那者没有对乐受的享受，但由于有与他的名身相应的极殊胜的乐，他的色身被由此乐所生的极殊胜的色法所遍满，因被遍满故，即使从禅那中出定后，也能感受到身乐。因此，为了显示此义，而说‘以身感受乐’。在‘诸圣者宣说他……’(yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti)等句中，‘yaṃ’是‘因为’的意思，即‘因为那个禅那’。‘taṃ’是指那个具足第三禅的补特伽罗(puggala)，诸佛等圣者宣说、称赞他。如何[称赞]呢？‘他是舍者，具念者，乐住者’。意思是：如此舍离一支，具足二支，具备三善等，在证得第三禅那后而行。至于在《分别论》(Vibhaṅga)中所说‘禅那是舍、念、正知、乐、心一境性’，那是为了显示包含其助伴的禅那而作的转义说。但就其审察相(upanijjhānalakkhaṇa)而言，应知此禅那仅有乐与心一境性二支。如其所说：‘禅那是二支的’等。
entries.english: Having thus shown the attainment of the second jhāna, now, for one who has attained the second jhāna, after he has mastered it in the way described and has seen the fault in it—because applied and sustained thought are its near enemies and because it possesses the gross factor of rapture—and after he has overcome delight in it, for the abandoning of that gross factor and for the attainment of the remaining peaceful factors, as he gives repeated attention to that same object, the third jhāna arises, and the supramundane jhāna based on it. To show this, the text begins, ‘With the fading away of rapture….’ Herein, virāga means fading away, transcending; hence virāgā (with the fading away). The word ‘and’ (ca) includes the stilling of applied and sustained thought, the meaning being: ‘with the fading away of rapture, and with the stilling of applied and sustained thought.’ This is stated to explain its path of approach and to praise it. ‘He dwells equanimous’: Herein, equanimity (upekkhā) means looking on with an attitude of neutrality, seeing without partiality; it is impartiality. Because one who has attained the third jhāna is endowed with this clear, powerful equanimity, which has the fading of rapture as its basis, he is called ‘equanimous.’ Moreover, because there is no disturbance from applied thought and so on, its function becomes fully manifest right here, not in the first jhāna and so on. ‘Mindful and clearly comprehending’: This refers to mindfulness and clear comprehension with the person as the basis. And this happiness, which was accompanied by rapture, is now established by the power of mindfulness and clear comprehension. Being withdrawn from rapture, it does not go back to it, just as a calf, tied up, does not go back to the cow. And when this mindfulness is present, yogis are not infatuated by this exceedingly sweet happiness, as they otherwise would be. This too should be understood as stated here to show this special meaning. ‘And he experiences happiness with the body’: Herein, although one who has attained the third jhāna has no advertence to experiencing happiness, nevertheless, because there is for him an extremely sublime happiness associated with the mental body, and because the physical body is pervaded by the extremely sublime form born of that happiness, one who has emerged from that jhāna might experience bodily happiness due to that pervasion. Therefore, to show this meaning, it is said: ‘and he experiences happiness with the body.’ ‘That which the noble ones describe…’: Here, ‘that which’ (yaṃ) means ‘because of which’ (yasmā), that is, ‘because of this jhāna.’ ‘That’ (taṃ) refers to the person who has attained the third jhāna, whom the noble ones, such as the Buddhas, describe and praise. How? As ‘equanimous, mindful, a happy dweller.’ Thus, having abandoned one factor and possessing two factors, endowed with the threefold excellence, one attains and abides in the third jhāna. This is the meaning. But as to the jhāna which in the Vibhaṅga is described as: ‘Jhāna is equanimity, mindfulness, clear comprehension, happiness, and unification of mind’ (Vibh. 591), that is stated figuratively to show the jhāna with its accessories. However, it should be understood as having two factors in terms of the characteristics of absorption, namely, happiness and unification of mind. As it is said: ‘The jhāna has two factors,’ and so on (Vibh. 624).

entries.pali: Sīlañca paññāṇañca sīlapaññāṇaṃ, samatho ca vipassanā ca samathavipassanaṃ, vijjā ca caraṇañca vijjācaraṇaṃ. Evaṃ satisampajaññaṃ, hiriottappaṃ, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ, thinamiddhaṃ iccādi.
entries.chinese_simplified: 戒(sīla)与慧(paññāṇa)合为“戒慧”(sīlapaññāṇaṃ)，止(samatha)与观(vipassanā)合为“止观”(samathavipassanaṃ)，明(vijjā)与行(caraṇa)合为“明行”(vijjācaraṇaṃ)。如是，正念与正知合为“正念正知”(satisampajaññaṃ)，惭与愧合为“惭愧”(hiriottappaṃ)，掉举与恶作合为“掉举恶作”(uddhaccakukkuccaṃ)，昏沉与睡眠合为“昏沉睡眠”(thinamiddhaṃ)等。
entries.english: 'Sīlañca paññāṇañca' (virtue and wisdom) become 'sīlapaññāṇaṃ'. 'Samatho ca vipassanā ca' (tranquility and insight) become 'samathavipassanaṃ'. 'Vijjā ca caraṇañca' (knowledge and conduct) become 'vijjācaraṇaṃ'. Thus: 'satisampajaññaṃ' (mindfulness and clear comprehension), 'hiriottappaṃ' (moral shame and moral dread), 'uddhaccakukkuccaṃ' (restlessness and remorse), 'thinamiddhaṃ' (sloth and torpor), and so on.
